name: Centipede, Great Forest
body:
This lengthy, segmented horror writhes and twists, pulsing its venomous mandibles in search of prey.

Centipede, Great Forest

CR 6

XP 2,400
N Gargantuan vermin
Init +0; Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +7

DEFENSE

AC 17, touch 6, flat-footed 17 (+11 natural, -4 size)
hp 87 (7d8+49+7)
Fort +12, Ref +4, Will +2
Immune mind-affecting effects

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft., climb 40 ft.
Melee bite +13 (3d6+18 plus poison)
Special Attacks poison

STATISTICS

Str 34, Dex 11, Con 24, Int —, Wis 10, Cha 2
Base Atk +5; CMB +21; CMD 31 (can’t be tripped)
Feats Weapon Focus (bite)B, Skill Focus (Perception), Lightning Reflexes, Toughness
Skills Climb +20, Perception +7, Stealth -4; Racial Modifiers +4 Perception, +8 Stealth

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Poison (Ex)

Bite—injury; save Fort DC 22; frequency 1/round for 6 rounds; effect 1d3 Dex damage; cure 1 save. The save DC is Constitution-based and includes a +2 racial bonus.

ECOLOGY

Environment temperate or warm forest or underground
Organization solitary, pair, or colony (3–6)
Treasure none
